job_market_records.job_title: Senior AWS Solutions Architect — Cloud Transformation Practice
job_market_records.company_type: Big Four Consulting (Deloitte / KPMG / Accenture tier)
skills_required: AWS Organizations and Control Tower Landing Zone
AWS networking — VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53
AWS security — GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM, KMS, WAF
skills_preferred: SC Clearance or eligibility (5-year UK address history required)
responsibilities_verbatim: Define cloud strategy, governance frameworks, and AWS architecture standards
Designing and delivering cloud-native and migration solutions on AWS
Lead AWS Landing Zone and Control Tower implementations
Drive Terraform Infrastructure as Code and DevOps automation
Design AWS networking solutions including Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and hybrid connectivity
AWS governance and multi-account management (AWS Organisations, SCPs, Landing Zones)
HLD/LLD production and architecture governance
AWS security and compliance including GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM, KMS, and AWS Config

key_evidence: Completed ADR-001 and designed 10-account Control Tower Landing Zone with 4 OUs and 3 SCP guardrails
Fixed and extended Terraform VPC module (5 bugs) — committed to GitHub
Designed hub-and-spoke network with Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, WAF, GuardDuty across all accounts
Produced HLD + LLD + Governance Framework for FCA-regulated environment
Delivered 12-minute executive ARB presentation to CTO, CFO, CRO, and 2 NEDs
simulation_match.gap: SC Clearance eligibility depends on candidate's 5-year UK address history — not demonstrable through simulation

skills_required: AWS IAM, networking, KMS, RDS, multi-account architecture
responsibilities_verbatim: Own the AWS platform architecture and modernisation roadmap, including migration from a Java monolith to microservices on EKS
Define standards for containers, runtime environments, observability, tenancy, security, and infrastructure automation
Lead SRE practices including SLI/SLOs, incident management, DR/BCP planning, post-mortems, and operational resilience
Strong AWS expertise including EKS, IAM, networking, KMS, RDS, and multi-account architecture
Own design, security, reliability, and operational management of AWS platform
Provide technical leadership across project lifecycles, from inception to deployment

key_evidence: Deployed 4 microservices on EKS with ArgoCD GitOps — fixed 5 manifest bugs including PCI-DSS NetworkPolicy isolation for Payments Service
Built Grafana SLI/SLO dashboards with 99.95% Payments SLO and error budget tracking (21.9 min/month)
Wrote PAR-DB-012 incident report with root cause, impact (312 users, 58 min), and preventive recommendations
Produced SLO runbook with FCA PS21/3 operational resilience alignment
Designed DR architecture with Aurora Multi-AZ (RTO 15min, RPO 0) for all 4 P1 Critical no-DR apps
simulation_match.gap: No post-mortem facilitation section in simulation — candidate should describe their PAR-DB-012 incident report as equivalent experience

job_market_records.company: Amazon Web Services (AWS EMEA SARL — UK Branch)
skills_required: Data architecture — Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation
responsibilities_verbatim: Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
Work directly with customers to accelerate complex projects
Support the Full Customer Lifecycle: Engage with customer architecture and security teams during pre-sales and post-sales phases, acting as the technical bridge
Building relationships with customers including C-suite and Line of Business stakeholders
Deep experience in cloud data architecture (AWS, Redshift, Glue, S3, Lambda, Bedrock)
Hands-on understanding of BI, modelling, lineage
Act as an incubator for modernisation of application, technical and security services through adoption of cloud-native solutions

key_evidence: Designed enterprise data platform: S3 data lake (raw/processed/curated), Glue ETL, Athena, Redshift Serverless, Lake Formation GDPR governance
Designed Amazon Bedrock RAG architecture with Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch Serverless vector store, and Guardrails for FCA COBS compliance
Delivered 12-minute executive ARB presentation to CTO, CFO, CRO, and 2 NEDs including a non-technical finance NED
Migrated Oracle 12c to Aurora PostgreSQL with SCT + DMS + CDC — saving £340k/year in licence costs
simulation_match.gap: AWS SA Professional role typically requires pre-sales experience — simulation does not cover customer discovery/pre-sales process. Candidate should supplement with real AWS consulting experience.

skills_required: AWS multi-account architecture and Control Tower
Security architecture for regulated financial services

key_evidence: Designed and documented FCA PS21/3-aligned architecture across all 9 programme phases
Produced formal Risk Register with FCA/PRA regulatory references, SMCR accountable individuals, and remediation phases — signed off by CRO
